title: Account mandates, ownership and signing controls
workflow: Determine account ownership structure at onboarding
Collect source-backed signatory identity and mandate scope
Check guardianship or company representation as relevant
Approve and version authorized signing arrangement
Evaluate each financial command against current mandate and thresholds
Revoke/change mandate with immutable audit and notifications
invariants: Beneficial owner and authorized signer are not interchangeable roles
Expired/revoked mandate cannot authorize subsequent instructions
Signing rules must be checked server-side per action
Joint approvals must reference distinct authorized subjects
Mandate changes cannot retroactively authorize past transactions
Cross-account signing right does not imply cross-institution permission
planned_tests: Old mandate still reconstructs historical approval
approval_gate: Local legal and institutional mandate policy, customer signed agreements and identity authorization tests.
